clauses.reason: This clause adds section 306 (Development Coordination Committee) to Executive Order No. 10973 and states "there is hereby established a Development Coordination Committee". Executive Order 12163 (signed September 29, 1979; 44 FR 56673) states in section 1-903(a) that the following are revoked: "(1) Executive Order No. 10973 of November 3,1961, as amended;" and in section 1-905 "The provisions of this order shall become effective as of October 1,1979." Its section 1-505 establishes a Development Loan Committee and its section 1-506 a Development Coordination Committee, which are new committees under that order and are not treated as keeping this order in force. Executive Order 11579 section 4(d) (1971) supersedes Executive Order No. 10973 only insofar as provisions conflict; it names no section of this order's insertion and no source shows it extinguished the amendment, so it is not an end.

research_rationale:
Identity: the held Federal Register text (40 FR 8933, issue of March 4, 1975) is Executive Order 11841, Amending Executive Order No. 10973, Relating to Administration of Foreign Assistance and Related Functions, to Provide for a Development Coordination Committee. I read the whole order: it amends the parent by adding at the end of Part III a new section 306, in which paragraph (a) states "there is hereby established a Development Coordination Committee", paragraph (b) allows consultation with other agencies, and later paragraphs give the Committee advisory and coordination functions. The representation is the machine-extracted text layer of the official PDF. End: the parent, as amended, was revoked by Executive Order 12163, effective October 1, 1979, Executive Order 12163 (signed September 29, 1979; 44 FR 56673) states in section 1-903(a) that the following are revoked: "(1) Executive Order No. 10973 of November 3,1961, as amended;" and in section 1-905 "The provisions of this order shall become effective as of October 1,1979." Its section 1-505 establishes a Development Loan Committee and its section 1-506 a Development Coordination Committee, which are new committees under that order and are not treated as keeping this order in force. Executive Order 11579 section 4(d) (1971) supersedes Executive Order No. 10973 only insofar as provisions conflict; it names no section of this order's insertion and no source shows it extinguished the amendment, so it is not an end. Section 306 existed only inside the parent, so it ended with the parent on 1979-10-01.

savings.reason: Executive Order 12163 section 1-904 states that "Except to the extent inconsistent with this order, all delegations of authority"... shall continue in full force and effect until amended, modified, or terminated by appropriate authority; the Development Coordination Committee itself is re-established under section 1-506 with a different membership.
